main_text.l: Felix qui Vita & mortis sic diuidis annos,
Vita tibi Vt condat, Mors tibi promat opes.
Iam nunc Virentes arbor attollens comas,
Quàm nostra forte Vita fertur dispari!

page.notes: The drop-cap initials D and T are large woodcut letters, joined to the following words. The word after the drop cap D ("Diuitiis") is uncertain in the scan and is marked [?]. Horizontal rules separate the sections and are not transcribed. No marginal notes or catchword are printed.
